title: Componentwise finite constant sheaves on a finite clopen union are constructible
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring, let $Y=\coprod_{a=1}^rY_a$ be a finite disjoint union of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with each $Y_a$ open and closed in $Y$, and let $M_a$ be a finite $\Lambda$-module, with constant sheaves as in [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Define a sheaf of $\Lambda_Y$-modules $E$ on the small etale site of $Y$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], as a module sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] by
$$E(W)=\prod_{a=1}^r\underline{M_a}_{Y_a}(W\times_Y Y_a)$$
for every etale $W\to Y$, with componentwise restrictions and module operations. Then the clopen partition $Y=\coprod_aY_a$, together with the constant finite module restriction $E|_{Y_a}\cong\underline{M_a}_{Y_a}$, is a constructibility stratification [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]; in particular $E$ is constructible as a $\Lambda$-module sheaf in that sense and also in [def-constructible-constructible] for the coefficient category of $\Lambda$-modules.
